_about: For every record of data/sources/, the records of data/reproduce/sources.json (spinesurg-ct-nnunet's data platform) that hold its manifest: how it was acquired, from where, the checks on a copy, and how it is fetched again. 'family:B' stands for every manifest record of family B, the anomaly harvest. An empty list means no manifest record exists; the basis says why. tools/reproduce_table.py renders docs/research/datasets-reproduce.md from this file and fails its check when an id here is unknown or a registry record is missing.
